author: Lucartex
body:
Edit: I joined Jalapenos! 

     Hello! 
I am looking for a team again!

I doubt that I will find one, but it is worth trying it, isn't it?
You can look up my stats and ask me questions if you want to.

I used to be a rusher, but I changed to more defensive gameplay because I am more the guy who wants to make sure that the enemies do not approach too far.

My bridging skills are pretty advanced, I am very good at jitterbridging and can do pretty much every kind of bridging (not including breezily which I was able to do a short time ago, but now I have come out of practise).

My KD is pretty bad because I started playing on this server a long time ago when I was noob.

So, now to the problems:

I am German and because of this I can't skype or teamspeak with you.
I  don't even have a microphone anymore ;-;

These are pretty big problems, but I still hope that there is some team I can help out.

replies.body:
Hi :3

My team, Jalapenos would love to try you out. Now of course, the whole 'can't talk on ts and skype' is a very big issue, mainly because it makes you a lot less valuable during scrim :/

But i'm sure we could make it work if you were able to at least listen in on Ts? 
If you are fine with that then go ahead and apply and we'll trial you :D

Defender application: https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/8VM3PWD

Rusher application: https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/87LKLJH
